Comment FIBRE for your free 30g fibre counter 🥣

The supermarket says we need protein in everything, from crisps to coffee. The UK data tells a different story.

The UK fibre target is 30g a day, and the British Nutrition Foundation says only around 4% of adults hit it. Fibre feeds the good bacteria in your gut and keeps things moving. (The exception on protein is older adults, who are more likely to fall short.)

Every swap here costs less than a protein bar.

Team protein or team fibre?

Save this for your next Tesco shop, and send it to the friend whose cupboard is full of protein bars.
